newsitem.title: USA: Knight-Ridder Sept oper revs up 3.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: Knight-Ridder Sept oper revs up 3.6 pct.

text.p: MIAMI, Oct 28 (Reuter) Knight-Ridder Inc said Monday that total operating revenue in September was $212.7 million, up 3.6 percent from $205.2 million the same period a year ago.
Year-to-date operating revenue was $2.1 billion, a 3.4 percent increase from $2 billion the same period in the prior year.
Newspaper revenue was up 13 percent to $186.5 million in September. Year-to-date, newspaper revenue was up 7.7 percent to $1.74 billion.
Total advertising lineage in September rose 17.9 percent to 2.8 million inches and was up 13.5 percent to 25.5 million inches year-to-date.
Pro forma operating revenue was up 4.6 percent for the month and up 3.7 percent for the year to date.

Pro forma comparisons assume that Contra Costa Newspapers were part of Knight-Ridder since the beginning of last year and exclude Detroit newspapers, where there has been a strike, and Knight-Ridder Financial, which was sold in July 1996.
Revenue in September for Knight-Ridder's business information services were $26.2 million, down 34.8 percent over the same period in the prior year when that unit posted $40.1 million in revenues.
Year-to-date, business information services took in $325.2 million in revenues versus $381.2 million for the same period in the prior year, representing a 14.7 percent drop.
